title: Aspire Pixo Aura Pod Vape Kit
description: The Aspire Pixo Aura Pod Vape Kit is a compact yet powerful device designed to suit a wide range of vaping preferences, from mouth-to-lung (MTL) to restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) and direct-to-lung (DTL) styles. Its built-in 1300mAh battery supports adjustable power output up to 30W, giving you the freedom to enjoy a tailored vaping experience all day long. Offering a simplified and intuitive setup, the Aura features inhale activation and Smart Mode, which automatically adjusts the wattage based on the pod’s resistance. Instead of a full screen, a discreet hidden indicator displays the battery percentage, keeping the device discreet and easy to use. A side-slider airflow control lets you refine your draw for a tighter or more open inhale. Each kit includes a refillable 2ml Pixo pod with a 0.6ohm mesh coil preinstalled. This pod uses a convenient side-fill design with a silicone stopper for clean, mess-free refills. The Aspire Pixo pods are designed for use with both nic salt and 50/50 e-liquids , depending on your chosen resistance. With multiple colour finishes and a feature set aimed at both beginners and experienced vapers, the Aspire Pixo Aura is a capable, stylish device that’s built for daily reliability. Explore our vape liquids online selection and choose the flavour that best suits this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
